verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents sending email directly from the CRM and automating personalized prospect emails through Action Plans, which can be applied to a person. Only marketing-level one-liners describe this, so templating and multi-step sequencing are implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of email templates, evidence that Action Plans are multi-step sequences with timed steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send templated emails or multi-step sequences to prospects from inside the CRM

citations.quote: Call, text and email directly from FUB
Automate follow up with Action Plans
Automate personalized emails, texts, and calls for all your prospects
Apply an Action Plan to a person.
